input.command: $p="$env:APPDATA\npm\node_modules\@anthropic-ai\claude-code"; if (Test-Path $p) { Get-Content "$p\package.json" -TotalCount 8; Get-ChildItem $p | Select-Object Name,Length } else { "no npm package dir" }; "--- exe version"; & "$env:USERPROFILE\.local\bin\claude.exe" --version
input.description: Inspect the npm package and exe version
